stussireis.text_1: Digital platform for a law firm in Niterói-RJ specializing in Pension Law (INSS), Consumer Protection, and Civil Law.
stussireis.text_2: The primary objective was to create a modern and welcoming legal consultation booking experience with founding partners Dr. Felipe Reis and Dr. Saulo Stussi.
stussireis.text_3: Explore the complete platform on the link below:

case_study.summary: Digital platform for a law firm in Niterói-RJ specializing in Pension Law (INSS), Consumer Protection, and Civil Law.
case_study.problem: Clients facing complex pension benefit issues and banking fraud required transparent legal guidance and streamlined consultation triage.
case_study.solution: Built a high-performance Next.js enterprise web application with navy & gold branding, practice area search, and direct WhatsApp integration.
architecture_highlights: Scalable Next.js App Router architecture with Server-Side Rendering.
Structured SEO powered by Schema.org LegalService for Google indexing.
Responsive Design System styled with Tailwind CSS and fluid Framer Motion animations.
technical_challenges: Ensuring OAB regulatory compliance and local SEO optimization for Niterói/RJ.
Structuring intake forms by legal specialty (Pension vs Consumer Protection).
captions: Personalized legal consultation with founding partners.
Founding partners Dr. Felipe Reis and Dr. Saulo Stussi.
Solid institutional brand identity representing justice and civil law.

nerytour.text_1: Premium private mobility and receptive tourism portal for executive transfers and tours along the Pernambuco and Alagoas coastline.
nerytour.text_2: The goal was to enable tourists and executives to book private transfer services with estimated travel times and instant support.
nerytour.text_3: Access the booking platform on the link below:

case_study.summary: Premium private mobility and receptive tourism portal for executive transfers and tours along the Pernambuco and Alagoas coastline (Recife, Porto de Galinhas, Maragogi, Olinda).
case_study.problem: Travelers and corporate clients needed transparent booking for transfers with guaranteed luxury vehicles, safety, and 24/7 punctuality.
case_study.solution: Engineered a modern Next.js web application featuring a dynamic background video hero, interactive destination catalog with travel estimates, and instant booking.
architecture_highlights: Optimized video background with lazy loading and adaptive rendering.
Reusable components in Tailwind CSS and high-fidelity vector icons.
Seamless WhatsApp API integration for instant reservation confirmations.
technical_challenges: Optimizing video hero without impacting initial page load time on mobile networks.
Tailoring 1-click booking UX for mobile users navigating on the go.
captions: Private transfers with pickup at Recife International Airport.
Exclusive tours in Porto de Galinhas with licensed fleet.
Executive transfers to Maragogi with tailored quotes.

all_tasty_caffe.text_1: A sleek and modern website designed for a coffee shop featuring the main menu, contact information, and details about community services.
all_tasty_caffe.text_2: The primary objective was to showcase the full range of products while conveying the atmosphere of a cozy, welcoming shop that invites customers in.
all_tasty_caffe.text_3: Please, feel free to explore the shop website on the link below:

case_study.summary: Stylized digital platform for an artisanal cafe with interactive menus and local community integration.
case_study.problem: The cafe required a strong web presence reflecting its cozy physical store ambiance and highlighting specialty coffee offerings.
case_study.solution: Designed an interactive React/Vite website with modular components, smooth micro-animations, and dedicated showcases for hot beverages and events.
architecture_highlights: Lightning-fast build with Vite & React TypeScript.
Custom UI components with Chakra UI and fluid transitions.
Dynamic menu with real-time category filtering.
technical_challenges: Visual optimization of high-resolution food and beverage photography.
Responsive layout tailored to mobile customers visiting on-site.
captions: Vibrant landing page with artisanal coffee aesthetic.
Interactive hot beverages and specialty coffee menu.
Community page highlighting local events and partnerships.

voar_bem.text_1: This project is a travel agency platform focused on personalized packages, offering flights, hotels, and rentals.
voar_bem.text_2: The main goal is to connect users with exclusive travel deals, featuring significant discounts and a selection of accommodations carefully curated for different traveler profiles.
voar_bem.text_3: Through a modern and interactive design, users can easily request a free, no-obligation quote by providing their travel preferences directly on the site.

case_study.summary: Travel agency web platform focused on custom vacation packages, real-time quotes, and accommodation booking.
case_study.problem: Building a seamless search experience for flights, hotels, and tours that efficiently converts visitors into qualified sales inquiries.
case_study.solution: Developed a Next.js web application with a dynamic hotel catalog, interactive destination filtering, and a smart quote request engine.
architecture_highlights: Scalable Next.js App Router architecture with TypeScript.
Dynamic client-side filters and accommodation search engine.
Lead forms routed directly to sales team workflow.
technical_challenges: Managing flight & hotel search state with zero latency.
Responsive layout optimized for mobile travelers researching on the go.
captions: Interactive Hero with destination & package search engine.
Hotel catalog with price range and amenity filters.
Vacation package detail page with 1-click quote request.

lucas_alves.text_1: A portfolio website showcasing the primary body of work of a professional photographer, including an extensive collection of photographs and photo shoots.
lucas_alves.text_2: The primary objective was to design a concise and refined user interface while ensuring an excellent user experience.
lucas_alves.text_3:
Next, present essential information about how the photo shoots are conducted, along with a clear method of communication.

case_study.summary: High-fidelity visual portfolio for a professional photographer featuring optimized high-resolution image delivery.
case_study.problem: Photographers require clean visual presentation where heavy high-res imagery must not compromise page speed or search rankings.
case_study.solution: Built on Next.js with SSR/ISR and advanced image optimization (`next/image`), delivering elegant galleries with progressive loading and lazy-loading.
architecture_highlights: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) with Next.js Image Optimization.
Modern Glassmorphism aesthetics styled with Tailwind CSS.
Streamlined booking workflow for photography client sessions.
technical_challenges: Maintaining 60fps in media-heavy galleries without layout shifts (CLS 0).
Color profile fidelity preservation and WebP/AVIF smart compression.
captions: Minimalist homepage highlighting featured photography sessions.
Works gallery and full portfolio with category filters.
Client testimonials section and booking channel.

jaqueline_e_lucas.text_1: Interactive wedding web application celebrating the union of Jaqueline & Lucas in Viseu, Portugal.
jaqueline_e_lucas.text_2: The goal was to provide a magical experience for guests with RSVP management, event schedule, and digital gift registry.
jaqueline_e_lucas.text_3: Explore the wedding event page on the link below:

case_study.summary: Interactive wedding web application celebrating the union in Viseu, Portugal, featuring RSVP management, event schedule, and digital gift registry.
case_study.problem: Managing guest invitations across Portugal and Brazil while centralizing gift contributions via IBAN, MB WAY, and PIX.
case_study.solution: Built an elegant Next.js web application with a live countdown timer, ceremony timeline, and 1-click bank key copying.
architecture_highlights: Dynamic countdown timer supporting global time zones.
Fast copy system for IBAN (Portugal), MB WAY, and PIX (Brazil).
Editorial typography and fluid mobile navigation.
technical_challenges: Handling multiple international payment methods intuitively.
Fast RSVP forms with guest list lookup.
captions: Digital invitation cover featuring Jaqueline & Lucas custom monogram.

sogrape_wines.text_1: A web application with two primary functionalities: collecting wine prices through web scraping and presenting the collected data via an interactive dashboard.
sogrape_wines.text_2: Using this tool, the company was able to collect valuable data and develop commercial strategies aimed at enhancing both sales performance and overall business planning.
sogrape_wines.text_3: The software is proprietary to the company; therefore, no deployment link is available. Feel free to contact me to discuss it further — I would be happy to share more details.

case_study.summary: Enterprise Commercial Intelligence & Automated Wine Price Scraping Engine for competitive market analysis.
case_study.problem: The company needed to automatically monitor wine pricing and inventory across multiple international e-commerce sites without time-consuming manual processes.
case_study.solution: Engineered automated extraction bots using Python & Selenium connected to a FastAPI backend and MySQL database, rendered on a real-time analytics dashboard.
architecture_highlights: Asynchronous extraction pipelines built with Python & Selenium in headless mode.
High-throughput RESTful API powered by FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.
MySQL database optimized for historical price point analytics.
technical_challenges: Bypassing anti-scraping mechanisms and dynamic store layout changes.
Standardizing and deduplicating bottle catalogs and vintage years.
Rendering real-time comparative data charts for executive strategy.
captions: Product catalog dashboard with advanced search and filters.
Individual bottle overview with historical price variations.
Comparative analytics chart mapping market positioning.
